name: LazyAds API
description: Programmatic access to campaigns, performance, creatives, competitors, account signals (pixels, conversion-event volume, audiences), server-side conversion events, and outbound webhooks. Every endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` and a Growth, Scale, or Enterprise plan (BYOA and Starter keys work with the MCP server at https://mcp.lazyads.ai/mcp instead). Lazy Ads AI endpoints (`/campaigns/build`, `/chat`, `/competitors/ads`) additionally require an AI plan. Rate limits are per key per minute (Growth 100, Scale 500, Enterprise 1000) and returned in `X-RateLimit-*` headers. Agencies may scope a request to a client workspace with the `X-LazyAds-Client` header.
